name: Yamoussoukro
subtitle: Yamoussoukro, capital of Côte d'Ivoire: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The Basilica of Notre-Dame de la Paix is the largest Christian church in the world by surface area, featuring a 158-metre dome.

parts.text: The city is celebrated for its wide multi-lane boulevards, the colossal Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, the UNESCO-affiliated Félix Houphouët-Boigny Peace Foundation, and its sacred crocodile lakes.

items.text: The monumental Félix Houphouët-Boigny Foundation for Peace Research is completed.
Pope John Paul II consecrates the Basilica of Our Lady of Peace.

gaps: Civil servant relocation progress metrics from Abidjan to Yamoussoukro are partially documented.
First-hand local voices from Baoulé textile weavers in surrounding villages are missing.
